chunks: And whatever is in it from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Qummi, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Qummi, from al-Rida, peace be upon him.

key_terms.الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam al-Rida, peace be upon him, the ultimate source named in this chain
key_terms.الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْقُمِّيِّ: A narrator through whom this material is transmitted
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: A supplication meaning: may Allah be pleased with him
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a statement of direct transmission by the compiler

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Qummi in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Qummi. It serves as a chain-of-transmission notice in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih, linking the report ultimately to al-Rida عليه السلام.
